mapper.insert: insert into emp(username, password, name, gender, phone, job, salary, image, entry_date, dept_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{emp.username}, #{emp.password}, #{emp.name}, #{emp.gender}, #{emp.phone}, #{emp.job}, #{emp.salary}, #{emp.image}, #{emp.entryDate}, #{emp.deptId}, #{emp.createTime}, #{emp.updateTime})
mapper.select: select e.*, d.name as deptName, ee.id as expr_id, ee.emp_id as expr_emp_id, ee.begin as expr_begin, ee.end as expr_end, ee.company as expr_company, ee.job as expr_job from emp e left join dept d on e.dept_id = d.id left join emp_expr ee on e.id = ee.emp_id where e.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update emp set username = #{emp.username}, name = #{emp.name}, gender = #{emp.gender}, phone = #{emp.phone}, job = #{emp.job}, salary = #{emp.salary}, image = #{emp.image}, dept_id = #{emp.deptId}, entry_date = #{emp.entryDate}, update_time = #{emp.updateTime} where id = #{emp.id}
